svg.text: Deep Water edition · 16 individual vector illustrations

g.title: Clover the crab
g.desc: A copper reef crab with a broad carapace, tiny watchful eyes and articulated claws. Deep Water edition, editable vector on a transparent background.

g.title: Moss the turtle
g.desc: A gliding sea turtle with long paddle-like flippers, fine shell markings and jade tones. Deep Water edition, editable vector on a transparent background.

g.title: Juno the jelly
g.desc: A translucent moon jelly with a ribbed bell, delicate trailing filaments and soft bioluminescence. Deep Water edition, editable vector on a transparent background.

g.title: Pip the fish
g.desc: A streamlined blue tang with a small amber-ringed eye and warm yellow fins. Deep Water edition, editable vector on a transparent background.

g.title: Otto the octopus
g.desc: A copper-rose octopus with an elongated mantle, small lateral eyes and eight flowing arms. Deep Water edition, editable vector on a transparent background.

g.title: Winnie the whale
g.desc: A streamlined pearl-grey whale with a long pectoral fin and sculptural tail flukes. Deep Water edition, editable vector on a transparent background.

g.title: Sunny the star
g.desc: An asymmetric sand-coloured sea star with delicate rows of raised surface dots. Deep Water edition, editable vector on a transparent background.

g.title: Shell badge
g.desc: An opalescent blue-grey scallop shell with slender sculpted ridges. Deep Water edition, editable vector on a transparent background.

g.title: Pearl points
g.desc: An ivory pearl resting in an open muted-rose and slate clamshell. Deep Water edition, editable vector on a transparent background.

g.title: Coral bloom
g.desc: A branching terracotta sea fan rising from a small cluster of ocean stones. Deep Water edition, editable vector on a transparent background.

g.title: Seaweed garden
g.desc: Sweeping jade kelp and translucent seafoam blades. Deep Water edition, editable vector on a transparent background.

g.title: Little wave
g.desc: A sculptural cobalt wave with an ivory foam edge. Deep Water edition, editable vector on a transparent background.

g.title: Harbor lighthouse
g.desc: A weathered ivory and indigo coastal lighthouse with a warm lantern. Deep Water edition, editable vector on a transparent background.

g.title: Buddy boat
g.desc: A timber sailboat with linen canvas sails and a muted coral pennant. Deep Water edition, editable vector on a transparent background.

g.title: Challenge stall
g.desc: A coastal expedition kiosk with a linen and indigo striped awning. Deep Water edition, editable vector on a transparent background.

g.title: Message bottle
g.desc: A weathered sea-glass bottle with a parchment note and a knotted cord. Deep Water edition, editable vector on a transparent background.
